definitions.explanation: A written piece presenting opinions and arguments on a topic, especially in a newspaper or magazine. Often refers to the editorial section or a signed opinion column.
A formal discussion or argument on a subject, presenting reasoned opinions and analysis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{論説|ろんせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{論説|ろんせつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{税制改革|ぜいせいかいかく}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This editorial makes sharp points about tax reform.

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境問題|かんきょうもんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧{論説|ろんせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (argument, discussion) and ⟦{説|せつ}→説：00360_setsu⟧ (theory, explanation). Refers to a reasoned presentation of opinions, ranging from newspaper editorials to academic treatises.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {論説|ろんせつ}⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧: editorial board member / editorial writer
- {論説|ろんせつ}⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧: editorial article
- {論説|ろんせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write an editorial
- {論説|ろんせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to publish a commentary
- {論説|ろんせつ}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: editorial column

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{社説|しゃせつ}→社説：04197_shasetsu⟧: newspaper editorial — specifically the unsigned editorial representing the paper's official position, while {論説|ろんせつ} can be signed and may appear in various media
- ⟦{評論|ひょうろん}→評論：05820_hyouron⟧: criticism; review — focuses on critical evaluation rather than presenting an argument
- ⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧: commentary; explanation — aims to explain rather than argue a position
- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧: thesis; academic paper — a formal scholarly work, usually longer and more structured
